actions.description:
Trigger A creature in the sportlebore swarm's area speaks, uses a verbal component, or opens its mouth

Effect A portion of the sportlebore swarm attempts to surge down the throat of the triggering creature, which must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:25|traits:damaging-effect] save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature gets a mouthful of sportlebores. It spits the insects out and avoids further damage, but it can't speak for 1 round, and if it was performing a verbal spellcasting action, the spell fails and the caster wastes the action.

Failure The creature takes @Damage[4d6[piercing]] damage from sportlebore bites, can't speak for 1 round, and loses a spell as noted under Success.

Critical Failure As failure, but the creature is also exposed to sportlebore infestation.
actions.name: Pour Down Throat
actions.trigger: A creature in the sportlebore swarm's area speaks, uses a verbal component, or opens its mouth

actions.description: Each creature in the sportlebore swarm's area takes @Damage[4d6[piercing]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:25|basic] save).
actions.name: Swarming Bites

actions.description:
Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:22]

Stage 1 carrier with no ill effect (1 day)

Stage 2 Enfeebled 1 (1 hour)

Stage 3 Enfeebled 2 (1 hour)

Stage 4 @Damage[4d6[bludgeoning]] damage (@Check[fortitude|dc:25|basic] save) as the host painfully vomits out a sportlebore swarm and returns to stage 1
actions.name: Sportlebore Infestation

name: Sportlebore Swarm
publicNotes: A swarm of sportlebores is a much more dangerous foe than a single insect.
